t: A fast Renesas microcontroller with Ethernet, USB, and vector math.
steps: Buy the EK-RA8M1 kit from Renesas or a distributor such as Avnet.
Install Renesas e2 studio with the Flexible Software Package.
Connect the kit to your computer with the included micro-USB cable.
Build and flash a blinky example to light an onboard LED.
Try the Zephyr board guide as an open source path with the Zephyr SDK.
Check jumper J61 before you use Ethernet or the memory card slot.
Plug in a Qwiic or Grove sensor and read its values.
Ask questions on the Renesas community forum.
meta: Open Code. From $62.82. A few stores.
